reviews.text: We can’t say enough positive comments re Kristine and the outstanding care that she has given to our cat over the past 10 years.  We trust her unconditionally and she has always gone above and beyond.  She even sends us daily pictures and written updates.  She will also willingly do extra chores around our condo. We plan on using her forever!!
Great service and communication! Couldn’t recommend more. Cares deeply for all furry friends.

We hired Kristine to watch our dog, Phil, during our wedding, and she was absolutely amazing! From the start, she was incredibly communicative and organized, which gave us so much peace of mind on an already busy day. We had a few …

Great people to work with. Have always taken great care of my dog and answer all my questions I have.  Their prompt response is amazing and the owner is truly an animal lover. Kristine has a passion for what she does and it shows in how she takes care of my dog. Thanks for always being available whenever we need your help.
